svg.aria-label: A Bond room: you ask the Bond agent for your USDC balance, it calls a Solana devnet tool and answers, then you pay Maya 5 USDC through Mobile Wallet Adapter and a confirmed receipt lands in the thread.
svg.title: One Bond thread, from a question to a settled payment

g.text: A replay of the real flow. Devnet, no real funds.
Every node is Ed25519-signed over RFC 8785
canonical JSON, and re-verified on read.
Agent tools run in the thread
tool_call and tool_result stream back as their
own nodes, so the room shows what the agent did.
Pay with the wallet you hold
Mobile Wallet Adapter signs, Seed Vault holds
the key; Bond only ever sees signed bytes.
A transferChecked on devnet lands as a
receipt card with an Explorer link.
Seeker build ships tonight. Who covers
Agent-reported. Not a signed on-chain receipt.
You hold 12.50 USDC and 1 SOL on devnet.
Want to settle up with Maya?
